notes:
- Your progress is saved when you close the window. Quitting with the window's X (or Alt+F4) in the
  middle of a game used to lose that game's XP, stats and map records.
- Hospital monitors beep in threes as intended (only the first beep played, and it logged an error).
- Perk bottles: fixed an error when a thrown bottle smashed on impact before its backup timer.
- Meet the specials: the first time a Screamer, Riot Guard, Bloater or Stalker shows up in a game, a
  card tells you what it does and how to beat it.
- Co-op: a Stalker no longer gets stuck in its leap pose on other players' screens.
- Balance: fewer special zombies at high rounds (their chance now grows more slowly), and fewer Riot
  Guards, Bloaters and Stalkers in general.
- Tested by playing 15 rounds on every map: buying doors, spinning the box, drinking perks, upgrading
  guns, using traps and every power-up, with no errors.
